title: Keto Venezuelan Penne Bowl
description: A warm and flavorful keto bowl inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, featuring penne pasta as the base, topped with a variety of delicious ingredients.

ingredients.name: Penne pasta
ingredients.notes: made from almond flour for a keto-friendly option

ingredients.name: Grass-fed beef
ingredients.notes: cooked to a safe internal temperature of 135°F (57°C)

instructions: Cook the penne pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the avocado oil over medium-high heat.
Add the grass-fed beef to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the lime juice and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add the cooked penne pasta to the skillet and toss with the beef and sauce until well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the penne bowl to a serving bowl and garnish with chopped cilantro.
